description: BUILDINGS — walkable houses, apartments and furnished rooms, built up in steps: mint_building, then furnishing / storeys, framing / roof / drainage, and IFC for BIM tools (export_model); design_interior fits out and styles one room of a house. Each result's `next` names the next steps' cards. Open for 'design me a two-storey house', 'a 20 by 24 living room', 'frame the house', 'the house as IFC for Revit', 'make my living room Japandi'. An institutional one-off is pack_object (edifice).

args.description: The member's arguments, as its manual specifies.

manual.description: A member name, or a list: returns just their manuals (description + inputSchema).

tool.description: Member to call. Omit to open the pack: a menu of its members.
